leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a linked list data structure with nodes containing value and next pointer properties
Construct a function that traverses a linked list to count its total number of nodes
Apply the two-pointer technique (fast and slow pointers) to find the middle node efficiently
Manipulate pointer references to navigate through linked list nodes without array conversion
Initialize and control pointer movement to handle both even and odd length lists
Integrate the middle-finding algorithm into a complete solution that returns the middle node
Configure test cases with various linked list lengths to validate the algorithm's correctness
